author: More Perfect Union
description: Donald Trump says gas prices skyrocketing is a small price to pay for his war against Iran. So we went to a gas station in Indiana, and people weren't happy. "He treats gas the same way as he treats American lives... 'Well, you know, some people are gonna have to die.'" Let us know in the comments what you're paying at the pump right now.
title: Americans react as Donald Trump calls rising gas prices "a small price" for Iran war

author: More Perfect Union
description:
The biggest meatpacking company on Earth is being rocked by a massive strike.

99% of the workers at this JBS plant voted to walk off the job.

Now nearly 4,000 workers with @ufcw are fighting for better, safer jobs.

JBS supplies beef to major food giants like McDonalds, Burger King, Costco, Kroger, and more.

Producer, Editor: Zach Ben-Amots
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: The First Meatpacking Strike Since 1985 Is Happening Now In Colorado
